items.item_text: De-escalation/behavioral health training, MAB Certification, or CPI Certification relevant training or experience
American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross Basic Life Support (BLS), or UC Davis Health CPR
One (1) year experience in an inpatient hospital setting.

Under the direction of a Registered Nurse, the Mental Health Worker (MHW) assists professional and technical personnel in the observation of patients, some of whom may require continuous, intermittent or video observation. The goal of observation is to prevent harm to the patient, staff, and to reassure patient safety and prevent any harm that may result in a negative medical outcome.
50% - Provides observation for patient safety. May assist professional and technical personnel

Mental Health Workers may assist the Registered Nurse with routine patient care such as feeding, hygiene needs, as well as organizing activities and interactive therapy sessions with continuous observation of patients. MHWs also help to ensure that a calm, safe setting is maintained while gaining insight into treatment options for patients and participating in patient’s treatment planning with nursing staff and doctors. MHWs will perform the duties of re-stocking the department.
10% - Maintains a clean, safe hospital environment
Ability to read and write in English language.
Ability to use a computer, keyboard, and/or mouse to appropriately utilize healthcare systems for documentation, communication, training/education and completion of schedule/time card.
Oral communication skills to effectively deal with patients, visitors, patients and staff.
Ability to maintain courteous, tactful relationships with visitors, patients and clinicians.
Ability to adjust workload under changing conditions, and remains confidential with all patient information.
